name: 02-bookstore-inventory
public_brief: Build/fix a bookstore inventory API: update must persist price; list must filter by category; search q must match title OR author. Make ./test.sh pass.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: update_book updates title/author/isbn/category/stock but silently ignores price even when sent
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: Assign book.price from request data (with Decimal/validation) before save, same as other fields.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: list_books reads `category` query param but never applies it to the queryset
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: When category is non-empty, filter with category__iexact for case-insensitive exact match.

defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.summary: list_books search `q` only filters title__icontains, not author
defects_INTERNAL_DO_NOT_TELL_CANDIDATE.fix_strategy: Use Q(title__icontains=q) | Q(author__icontains=q) so either field matches.
